subject: [PATCH] mm: fix cachestat NULL pgdat dereference on DAX mappings

reviews.author: Henry Martin
reviews.summary: Requested documentation of the new behavior in the syscall's kernel-doc and suggested sending a v2 patch with these changes.
reviews.raw_body:
> +1. This sounds good to me.
>
> Henry, would you mind sending v2 along this line?
>
> (and maybe add some documentation).

 Sure, v2 sent: cachestat() now skips the xarray walk for DAX mappings
 and reports all zeros, and the behaviour is documented in the syscall's
 kernel-doc.

 Link: https://lore.kernel.org/linux-mm/20261125030432.274396-1-bsdhenrymartin@gmail.com/

 Thanks,
 Henry

2026-11-25.patch_summary: Patch fixes a NULL pointer dereference in cachestat on DAX mappings by skipping the xarray walk and reporting zeros.

reviews.author: Nhat Pham
reviews.summary: Expressed agreement with the patch and suggested Henry send a v2 version addressing his request for documentation.
